facts.text: Noodles, extra hot, and keep the bowl coming. I have a long night ahead and it isn't going to be dry.
facts.why: Invented line signed Rick Deckard. At the noodle bar he orders 'Give me four' and 'And noodles'. His real voice-over fits the bar: 'Sushi. That's what my ex-wife used to call me. Cold fish.'
facts.fix: Sushi. That's what my ex-wife used to call me. Cold fish.

fix_note.text: Sushi. That's what my ex-wife used to call me. Cold fish.

facts.text: Deckard's order at the counter, haggled down.
facts.why: Backwards. Deckard asks for four, the cook says two is enough, and Deckard insists 'No. Four. Two, two, four.' He is not haggled down.
facts.fix: Deckard's order at the counter: four, not two
facts.applied_note: Shorter wording to stay within the length.

facts.why: Deckard drinks Johnnie Walker Black Label (Scotch) in Bryant's office, not Japanese whisky.
facts.applied_note: Recipe, note and shopping now use Scotch whisky to match the new name.

vibe.verdict: One of the stronger menus: the real White Dragon Noodle Bar, the four portions gag and the origami all work. The udon note and the whisky get Deckard wrong.
